assumptions: Explicit componentwise penalties on scaled deviations, not absolute physical properties unless reference0
Positive epsilon stages, actual objective nonincrease within each fixed stage (64 binary64 eps relative/absolute rounding allowance)
Bounded matrix-free convex quadratic inner solves; true-penalty projected gradient and step outer gate
p2 reproduces declared L2 objective; p<1 nonconvex and starting models/prior can select different solutions
Cartesian J componentwise sparsity and scales can favour axes; depth/sensitivity/volume weighting not inferred
Local quadratic condition bound is not nonlinear-Hessian conditioning or data-rank/geological uniqueness evidence
No local/global optimum or posterior uncertainty guarantee; actual work budgets shared across stages and replay QC
Linear TMI retains full-vector weak-response guard; exact-TMI plus sparse penalties is unsupported in v1

solver_policy.total_execution: top-level execution covers all stages/inner products/polishing/backtracking/final checks; nested execution is the standalone forward replay budget
solver_policy.outer_projected_gradient: half_actual_objective gradient divided by local quadratic Frobenius norm squared, projected to declared box
solver_policy.polish: bounded clipped unit gradient on normalized quadratic; Hessian norm<=1; shared work counter
solver_policy.backtracking: halve from previous model toward certified polished proposal; accepted actual objective must not increase beyond rounding allowance
solver_policy.history_inner_certificate: belongs to proposal; outer certificate and objective belong to accepted possibly backtracked model
solver_policy.active_bound: exact physical lower/upper bound after polishing/clipping
solver_policy.minimum_work: 5 setup products + at least 5 per stage, plus 3 vector-check calls/9 scalar-equivalent products for linear TMI. Preflight checks calls and geometry-scaled kernel terms; convergence may require more.
